messages:
lucy: Noticed odd stalls in sampleapp when running parallel paginated streaming + auth rotate. Streams hang but API shows no 429s or errors.
omar: which SDK/runtime?
lucy: js-sdk v1.12.3 with streaming + paging helper. config: concurrency 6, page_size 150, adaptiveWindow:true. Happens after ~20-40s once STS refresh kicks in.
tess: can you paste the minimal repro?
lucy: running the demo harness: 8 clients -> each requests paginated embeddings (cursor-based). After a while 2 streams stop receiving chunks. SDK still lists the request as inflight.
infra-bot: Deploy log: rotate-sts userkey (service-account) at 2026-02-15T12:05:23Z
omar: logs? any hint of semaphore/queue ops?
lucy: grabbed SDK debug: 
[DEBUG] backpressure: window resize 6->3
[DEBUG] auth: refresh started
[DEBUG] inflight: release 1 (stream#7)
[DEBUG] inflight: notify waiters -> 0
[DEBUG] stream#7: waiting for next chunk (no callback)
[DEBUG] inflight: acquire attempt timeout

tess: "notify waiters -> 0" looks wrong. we should not clear the waiter list while a stream expects a callback.
omar: maybe the refresh path calls resetInflight() which zeroes the waiter list before notifying. that would drop signals.
sam: I remember a previous fix where we moved notify() after we updated counters; could have regressed.
lucy: quick workaround for customers: set adaptiveWindow:false or reduce concurrency to 1-2. Also bump STS lifetime to avoid rotate during onboarding tests.
tess: plan: (1) add unit test that simulates STS refresh during active window shrink; (2) change resetInflight to snapshot and notify pre-existing waiters without clearing list until after notify; (3) add telemetry event backpressure.stalled_stream.
omar: I'll prototype the notify-before-clear patch on my branch.
sam: also add a guard in pagination helper to not enqueue next page if stream is flagged cancelled; might avoid duplicated queue entries.
olucy: will update sampleapp README with troubleshooting note.
infra-bot: PR #4412 opened by omar: fix(backpressure): preserve waiter notifications during auth refresh + tests. CI queued.
sam: nice. let's also add a short troubleshooting blurb to docs/onboarding about this class of issues.
lucy: thanks all. saving the debug trace here for support ticket: attach logs with SDK_DEBUG=backpressure,auth.
